2467!
2468! indorb are the number of orbitals occupied before calling
2469! this subroutine
2470!
2471! indpar is the number of variational parameters used
2472! before calling this subroutine
2473!
2474! indshell is the index of the last occupied orbital
2475! in the shell, characterized by occupation number iocc(indshell)
2476!
2477! z(i,indt+4) contains the laplacian of the orbital i
2478! z(i,indt+mu) contains the gradient of the orbital i (mu=1,2,3)
2479! In the following given a radial part of the orbital f(r)
2480! fun=1/r d f(r)/d r
2481! fun2= d^2 f(r)/dr^2
2482
2483
2484
2485
2486 adi4ibuf=1
2487 adr8ibuf=1
2488
2489 SELECT CASE (iopt)
2490 CASE (80)
2491! Cyrus basis
2492! R(r)=exp(-z*r**2) single zeta
2493! if(iocc(indshellp).eq.1) then
2494 indorbp = indorb + 1
2495 dd1 = dd(indpar+1)
2496 dd2 = dsqrt(dd1)
2497! if(iflagnorm.gt.2) then
2498! c=(2.d0*dd1/pi)**(3.d0/4.d0)*ratiocs
2499! ratiocs--> ratiocs*(2/pi)**3/4
2500 c = dd1**0.75d0*ratiocs
2501! endif
2502 DO k=indtmin,indtm
2503 CALL pushreal8(adr8ibuf,adr8buf,cost)
2504 cost = dd1*r(k)**2/(1.d0+dd2*r(k))
2505 distp(k, 1) = c*dexp(-cost)
2506 END DO
2507 IF (typec .NE. 1) THEN
2508! the first derivative /r
2509 rp1 = dd1*r(0)**2
2510 rp2 = dd2*r(0)
2511 rp3 = (1.d0+rp2)**2
2512 fun = -(dd1*distp(0, 1)*(2.d0+rp2)/rp3)
2513! the second derivative
2514 funb = 2.d0*zb(indorbp, indt+4)
2515 fun2b = zb(indorbp, indt+4)
2516 zb(indorbp, indt+4) = 0.0_8
2517 DO i=3,1,-1
2518 funb = funb + rmu(i, 0)*zb(indorbp, indt+i)
2519 rmub(i, 0) = rmub(i, 0) + fun*zb(indorbp, indt+i)
2520 zb(indorbp, indt+i) = 0.0_8
2521 END DO
2522 distpb = 0.0_8
2523 temp2 = rp3**2
2524 temp1b = (4.d0*rp1-2.d0*rp2+4.d0*(rp1*rp2)+rp1**2-2.d0)*fun2b/&
2525& temp2
2526 temp1 = dd1*distp(0, 1)/temp2
2527 temp1b0 = temp1*fun2b
2528 rp1b = (2*rp1+4.d0*rp2+4.d0)*temp1b0
2529 temp0b0 = -(distp(0, 1)*(rp2+2.d0)*funb/rp3)
2530 dd1b = temp0b0 + r(0)**2*rp1b + distp(0, 1)*temp1b
2531 temp0 = dd1/rp3
2532 distpb(0, 1) = dd1*temp1b - temp0*(rp2+2.d0)*funb
2533 rp3b = -(temp0*temp0b0) - temp1*2*rp3*temp1b
2534 rp2b = 2*(rp2+1.d0)*rp3b - temp0*distp(0, 1)*funb + (4.d0*rp1-2.d0&
2535& )*temp1b0
2536 dd2b = r(0)*rp2b
2537 rb(0) = rb(0) + dd1*2*r(0)*rp1b + dd2*rp2b
2538 ELSE
2539 distpb = 0.0_8
2540 dd1b = 0.0_8
2541 dd2b = 0.0_8
2542 END IF
2543 DO i=indtm,i0,-1
2544 distpb(i, 1) = distpb(i, 1) + zb(indorbp, i)
2545 zb(indorbp, i) = 0.0_8
2546 END DO
2547 cb = 0.0_8
2548 DO k=indtm,indtmin,-1
2549 cb = cb + dexp(-cost)*distpb(k, 1)
2550 costb = -(c*dexp(-cost)*distpb(k, 1))
2551 distpb(k, 1) = 0.0_8
2552 CALL popreal8(adr8ibuf,adr8buf,cost)
2553 temp = dd2*r(k) + 1.d0
2554 temp0b = costb/temp
2555 tempb = -(dd1*r(k)**2*temp0b/temp)
2556 dd1b = dd1b + r(k)**2*temp0b
2557 rb(k) = rb(k) + dd2*tempb + dd1*2*r(k)*temp0b
2558 dd2b = dd2b + r(k)*tempb
2559 END DO
2560 IF (dd1 .EQ. 0.0) THEN
2561 dd1b = dd1b + ratiocs*0.75d0*dd1**(-0.25d0)*cb
2562 ELSE
2563 dd1b = dd1b + dd2b/(2.d0*dsqrt(dd1)) + ratiocs*0.75d0*dd1**(&
2564& -0.25d0)*cb
2565 END IF
2566 ddb(indpar+1) = ddb(indpar+1) + dd1b
2567 CASE (81)
2568! derivative of bump gaussian
2569! R(r)=c*exp(-z*r**2)*(3/4/z-r**2)
2570! if(iocc(indshellp).eq.1) then
2571 indorbp = indorb + 1
2572 dd1 = dd(indpar+1)
2573 dd2 = dsqrt(dd1)
2574! c=(2.d0*dd1/pi)**(3.d0/4.d0)*ratiocs
2575 c = dd1**0.75d0*ratiocs
2576 DO k=indtmin,indtm
2577 CALL pushreal8(adr8ibuf,adr8buf,cost)
2578 cost = dd1*r(k)**2/(1.d0+dd2*r(k))
2579 distp(k, 1) = c*dexp(-cost)
2580 END DO
2581 DO i=i0,indtm
2582 CALL pushreal8(adr8ibuf,adr8buf,cost)
2583 cost = (1.d0+0.5d0*dd2*r(i))/(1.d0+dd2*r(i))**2
2584 END DO
2585 IF (typec .NE. 1) THEN
2586! the first derivative /r
2587 rp1 = dd1*r(0)**2
2588 rp2 = dd2*r(0)
2589 rp3 = (1.d0+rp2)**2
2590 fun = 0.25d0*distp(0, 1)*(-14.d0-29.d0*rp2-12.d0*rp1+3.d0*rp1*rp2+&
2591& 2.d0*rp1**2)/rp3**2
2592! the second derivative
2593 funb = 2.d0*zb(indorbp, indt+4)
2594 fun2b = zb(indorbp, indt+4)
2595 zb(indorbp, indt+4) = 0.0_8
2596 DO i=3,1,-1
2597 funb = funb + rmu(i, 0)*zb(indorbp, indt+i)
2598 rmub(i, 0) = rmub(i, 0) + fun*zb(indorbp, indt+i)
2599 zb(indorbp, indt+i) = 0.0_8
2600 END DO
2601 distpb = 0.0_8
2602 temp11 = rp3**3
2603 temp9 = distp(0, 1)/temp11
2604 temp10 = rp1**3
2605 temp10b = 0.25d0*temp9*fun2b
2606 temp9b = 0.25d0*(34.d0*rp1-30.d0*rp2+118.d0*(rp1*rp2)+87.d0*rp1**2&
2607& +18.d0*(rp1**2*rp2)-5.d0*rp1**3-2.d0*(temp10*rp2)-14.d0)*fun2b/&
2608& temp11
2609 temp8 = rp3**2
2610 temp7 = distp(0, 1)/temp8
2611 temp8b = 0.25d0*temp7*funb
2612 rp1b = (2.d0*2*rp1+3.d0*rp2-12.d0)*temp8b + (18.d0*rp2*2*rp1-5.d0*&
2613& 3*rp1**2-2.d0*rp2*3*rp1**2+87.d0*2*rp1+118.d0*rp2+34.d0)*temp10b
2614 temp7b = 0.25d0*(3.d0*(rp1*rp2)-12.d0*rp1-29.d0*rp2+2.d0*rp1**2-&
2615& 14.d0)*funb/temp8
2616 rp3b = -(temp7*2*rp3*temp7b) - temp9*3*rp3**2*temp9b
2617 rp2b = (3.d0*rp1-29.d0)*temp8b + 2*(rp2+1.d0)*rp3b + (18.d0*rp1**2&
2618& -2.d0*temp10+118.d0*rp1-30.d0)*temp10b
2619 distpb(0, 1) = temp7b + temp9b
2620 dd2b = r(0)*rp2b
2621 rb(0) = rb(0) + dd1*2*r(0)*rp1b + dd2*rp2b
2622 dd1b = r(0)**2*rp1b
2623 ELSE
2624 distpb = 0.0_8
2625 dd1b = 0.0_8
2626 dd2b = 0.0_8
2627 END IF
2628 DO i=indtm,i0,-1
2629 temp6 = 4.d0*dd1
2630 temp5 = 3.d0/temp6
2631 temp5b = distp(i, 1)*zb(indorbp, i)
2632 distpb(i, 1) = distpb(i, 1) + (temp5-r(i)**2*cost)*zb(indorbp, i)
2633 dd1b = dd1b - temp5*4.d0*temp5b/temp6
2634 costb = -(r(i)**2*temp5b)
2635 temp4 = dd2*r(i) + 1.d0
2636 temp5b0 = costb/temp4**2
2637 temp4b0 = -((0.5d0*(dd2*r(i))+1.d0)*2*temp5b0/temp4)
2638 rb(i) = rb(i) + 0.5d0*dd2*temp5b0 + dd2*temp4b0 - cost*2*r(i)*&
2639& temp5b
2640 zb(indorbp, i) = 0.0_8
2641 CALL popreal8(adr8ibuf,adr8buf,cost)
2642 dd2b = dd2b + r(i)*temp4b0 + 0.5d0*r(i)*temp5b0
2643 END DO
2644 cb = 0.0_8
2645 DO k=indtm,indtmin,-1
2646 cb = cb + dexp(-cost)*distpb(k, 1)
2647 costb = -(c*dexp(-cost)*distpb(k, 1))
2648 distpb(k, 1) = 0.0_8
2649 CALL popreal8(adr8ibuf,adr8buf,cost)
2650 temp3 = dd2*r(k) + 1.d0
2651 temp4b = costb/temp3
2652 temp3b = -(dd1*r(k)**2*temp4b/temp3)
2653 dd1b = dd1b + r(k)**2*temp4b
2654 rb(k) = rb(k) + dd2*temp3b + dd1*2*r(k)*temp4b
2655 dd2b = dd2b + r(k)*temp3b
2656 END DO
2657 IF (dd1 .EQ. 0.0) THEN
2658 dd1b = dd1b + ratiocs*0.75d0*dd1**(-0.25d0)*cb
2659 ELSE
2660 dd1b = dd1b + dd2b/(2.d0*dsqrt(dd1)) + ratiocs*0.75d0*dd1**(&
2661& -0.25d0)*cb
2662 END IF
2663 ddb(indpar+1) = ddb(indpar+1) + dd1b
2664 CASE (82)
2665 dd1 = dd(indpar+1)
2666 dd2 = dsqrt(dd1)
2667! if(iflagnorm.gt.2) then
2668! ratiocp--> ratiocp*dsqrt(2.d0)*pi**(-0.75d0)*2**1.25
2669! c=dsqrt(2.d0)*pi**(-0.75d0)*(2.d0*dd1)**1.25d0*ratiocp
2670 c = dd1**1.25d0*ratiocp
2671! endif
2672 DO k=indtmin,indtm
2673 CALL pushreal8(adr8ibuf,adr8buf,cost)
2674 cost = dd1*r(k)**2/(1.d0+dd2*r(k))
2675 distp(k, 1) = c*dexp(-cost)
2676 END DO
2677! indorbp=indorb
2678!
2679 DO ic=1,3
2680 CALL pushinteger4(adi4ibuf,adi4buf,indorbp)
2681! if(iocc(indshell+ic).eq.1) then
2682 indorbp = indorb + ic
2683 END DO
2684! endif
2685 IF (typec .NE. 1) THEN
2686! fun=-2.d0*dd1*distp(0,1)
2687! fun2=fun*(1.d0-2.d0*dd1*r(0)**2)
2688 rp1 = dd1*r(0)**2
2689 rp2 = dd2*r(0)
2690 rp3 = (1.d0+rp2)**2
2691 fun = -(dd1*distp(0, 1)*(2.d0+rp2)/rp3)
2692! the second derivative
2693 fun2 = dd1*distp(0, 1)*(-2.d0-2.d0*rp2+4.d0*rp1+4.d0*rp1*rp2+rp1**&
2694& 2)/rp3**2
2695! indorbp=indorb
2696 DO ic=1,3
2697 CALL pushinteger4(adi4ibuf,adi4buf,indorbp)
2698! if(iocc(indshell+ic).eq.1) then
2699 indorbp = indorb + ic
2700 DO i=1,3
2701 IF (i .EQ. ic) THEN
2702 CALL pushinteger4(adi4ibuf,adi4buf,2)
2703 ELSE
2704 CALL pushinteger4(adi4ibuf,adi4buf,1)
2705 END IF
2706 END DO
